name: KNOWN GAP (legacy path): rewriting status: then flipping gets past the gate
description: #475 gap 1, pinned as current behavior. The run is still going (one job running), the model rewrites the loom-invocation block's status: to completed in one edit and flips the checkbox in the next. The gate reads the pre-image of the flip, which already says completed, so it records the completion with no contradiction even in deny mode. It closes for raw submissions only when loom_submit records them in the registry; the registry-path twin of this scenario is refused.
